profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mixiware Software Inc
profile.summary: Specialties: C#, ASP.NET Core MVC, Angular, Microservices, ASP.NET WebForms, ASP.NET MVC, Web API, RESTful API, Bootstrap, JavaScript, MS SQL Server, JQuery, WCF, Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.locationName: Hacienda Heights, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Client: InfoQuest Systems (Remote) | Apr 2021 – Apr 2026 
– Collaborated in the architecture and design of the latest version of InfoQuest’s goals and compensation 
management platform (ClearComp), a multi-tenant SaaS application used by enterprise clients to track 
employee performance and compensation plans.
– Served as the sole back-end API developer, independently designing, building, and maintaining two production .NET APIs from the ground up.
– Built the primary client-facing API consumed by an Angular front-end, featuring, among other things: a 
dynamic JSON rendering engine that instructs the front-end how to compose and display pages at runtime; Azure AD authentication with JWT token issuance via our own authentication authority; Jira integration for in-app ticket creation; template upload for tenant data population; and background report generation with notifications via SignalR.
– Built a dedicated data-ingestion API enabling tenants to upload batches of compensation data for 
downstream processing by the ETL team. – Designed and developed multiple Azure Functions handling background workloads including email delivery, asynchronous data parsing, communication with Jira services, and targeted SignalR notifications to individual users and groups.
– System fully hosted on Azure Services: App Services (API hosting), Microsoft Entra ID (user authentication), Key Vault (secrets management), Blob Storage (file storage), Redis Cache (performance), SignalR Service (real-time notifications), Azure Cognitive Translator (multi-language support), SQL Managed Instances (relational data), and Application Insights (monitoring and diagnostics).
– Stack: C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core Web API, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), JWT, Azure App Services, Azure 
Functions, Azure Key Vault, Blob Storage, Redis, SignalR, SQL Server Managed Instance, Application 
Insights, Azure Cognitive Translator, Jira API
positions.insights: Skills: Azure · Redis · Azure Key Vault · Azure Functions · Azure Logic Apps · SignalR · Azure DevOps · OpenTelemetry · Azure Storage · Microsoft Entra ID · C# · API Development · OAuth · OpenID · ASP.NET

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Hacienda Heights, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
– Contributed to the ongoing maintenance and feature development of HCOnline, an employer-sponsored 
health benefits portal serving plan members; implemented enhancements to both the Angular front-end and ASP.NET Core back-end APIs.
– Stack: Angular 9, C#, ASP.NET Core 3.0-3.1, APIs, SQL Server.
positions.insights: Skills: Angular · C# · ASP.NET · API Development · Microsoft SQL Server

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.locationName: Hacienda Heights, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Client: TheZane Software (Remote) | Jan 2018 – Feb 2020
– Built of a multi-tenant platform on Angular 5→7 enabling sales reps to create branded showrooms with per gallery pricing, online ordering, and email-based buyer access control.
– Designed the back-end composed of microservices on ASP.NET Core 2.1/2.2 with RabbitMQ for 
asynchronous messaging and SQL Server storage; integrated Azure for cloud hosting and Azure DevOps 
for CI/CD.
– Engineered an internal workforce-planning application (Angular 7 front-end, ASP.NET Core API with 
MongoDB back-end) to forecast man-hours, allocate resources across active projects, and model cost/profit scenarios.
– Led the team and contributed as one of engineers covering full-stack duties: 50% back-end API and service development, 50% front-end; participated in architecture, analysis, and design decisions.
– Stack: C#, ASP.NET Core 2.0–2.2, RESTful APIs, MediatR, Microservices, RabbitMQ, SQL Server, 
MongoDB, Docker, Azure, Angular 5/6/7, Bootstrap, Entity Framework.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · ASP.NET · Restful API · MediatR · Microservices · RabbitMQ · Microsoft SQL Server · MongoDB · Angular · Docker · Entity Framework

positions.locationName: Hacienda Heights, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description:
Client: Healthcare Partners – DaVita (Remote) | Jun 2008 – Oct 2017
– Led back-end development of the AIR internal request-management platform (ASP.NET Core MVC 5), 
streamlining how IT handled ad-hoc data and reporting requests across the medical group.
– Built the Sweeps application — a revenue-recovery system that detected unbilled procedure codes and 
resubmitted claims to health plans via RESTful API and FTP, directly improving collections for the medical 
group. (24-month engagement, ASP.NET MVC 5, C#.)
– Developed the Event Reporting system enabling staff at all facilities to submit, track, and resolve risk
management incidents; implemented multi-stage approval workflow with audit trail. (20 months, ASP.NET 
MVC 4/5, WCF, Web API.)
– Delivered the Patient Online Portal (POP) — a high-traffic patient self-service application supporting 
prescription refills, lab-result viewing, online bill pay, and PCP appointment scheduling. (24-month lead 
engagement, ASP.NET WebForms, WCF, Telerik.)
– Built the mobile extension of POP in two phases: an iUI-based iPhone/Android version followed by a jQuery Mobile version extending support to Windows Phone. (20 months.)
– Engineered POP Registration, Portal Admin (user management), Claims Portal, and Code Clearing 
applications — collectively handling patient onboarding, claims processing, and diagnosis-code dispute 
workflows.
– Consistently served as lead or senior developer; responsibilities split approximately 30% back-end services, 60% front-end, 10% database across engagements.
– Stack: C#, ASP.NET Core 1.1/2.0, ASP.NET MVC 4/5, ASP.NET WebForms (.NET 3.0–4.6), SQL Server 
2005–2012, Entity Framework, WCF, SQL Server Reporting Services, Docker, RESTful APIs, 
Bootstrap, jQuery.

positions.title: Senior Software Consultant
positions.description:
Client: Treasury Bank – Countrywide Bank – Bank of America (On premises) | Jun 2003 – May 2008
– Designed and built the Marketing database (SQL Server) and accompanying SSRS reports consumed by 
upper management to track retail account portfolio performance.
– Developed the BAS (Background Agent Service) engine — a Windows service framework enabling multiple independent agents to execute concurrently without requiring recompilation; delivered significant operational efficiency gains for the retail IT team.
– Contributed to the initial builds of the Retail Website and SavingsLink online account-opening applications, serving as part of the core engineering team for both launches. 
– Implemented the Enhanced Online Security module (SQL Server, ASPX, ISAPI filter) to control access to 
secured website features and perform identity verification via third-party vendor VerId.
– Built the Partner Referral application (DotNetNuke + SQL Server) enabling cross-department client referrals.
– Developed a nightly Windows service to snapshot the bank's full account portfolio and import it into the Marketing database, including parsing AS400 flat-file feeds.
– Stack: C#, ASP.NET WebForms (.NET 1.1–3.0), AJAX.NET, SQL Server 2000/2005, JavaScript, DHTML, 
Excel macros, Visual Studio. 

Client: MEDeMorphus (On premises) | Jan 2002 – May 2003
– Developed ASPX pages and business logic for the ePrescribing application (v1.x), enabling physicians to 
write and transmit prescriptions via Pocket PC.
– Built a new print/fax engine for ePrescribing, web services for multi-site data synchronization, and Windows services for internet-based data transfer.
– Developed MedeReg, an appointment scheduling and patient check-in application for medical groups. – Stack: C#, ASP.NET WebForms (.NET 1.0/1.1), MSMQ, Crystal Reports, XML, SQL Server 2000.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
– Delivered multiple n-tier e-commerce web applications for clients including buy.com (MS Passport 
integration), ehobbies.com (catalog and shopping cart), and iFilm (cast/crew/script management system). – Designed and developed COM+ middle-tier components, Active Server Pages front-ends, and SQL Server databases including stored procedures and triggers. – Stack: Visual Basic, COM+, ASP, SQL Server 7/2000, XML, XSL, Commerce Server 2000, JavaScript, 
VBScript.
positions.insights: Skills: Active Server Pages (ASP) · VBScript · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · HTML

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
– Maintained and enhanced financial applications built on VB3–VB5 with SQL Server 6.5 and Access back
ends; participated in SQL Server 6.5 → 7.0 migration and Y2K conversion.
– Developed an FTP-based data-exchange application to transmit and process feedback from a partner's 
remote server.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Member of the Service Components team, which was in charge of the development and maintenance of 14 components of the OS400.
